method: All original XLS BIFF cells independently matched to a LibreOffice XLSX conversion.
Every source data cell included in HTML with original number format, station pairing and row order.
Wide independent station/precipitation column pairs split into simple tables with captions, row headers, column headers and keyboard-accessible scrolling.
